name: Spotify Playlist Sync
description: Sync your Spotify playlists into Matinee. Tracks are matched against your music libraries, and songs you don't have appear as greyed-out "Not available" entries.
author: Michael André Reber

config.label: Spotify client ID
config.description: Create an app at developer.spotify.com and add the redirect URI that the "Connection" row below shows.

config.label: Spotify client secret
config.description: Leave empty to use PKCE, which is recommended.

config.label: Playlist owner (Matinee username)
config.description: Synced playlists are created for this Matinee account.

config.label: Playlists to sync
config.description: Only playlists you own or collaborate on are listed. Spotify no longer serves other people's tracks over its API.

config.label: Sync now
config.description: During a running sync, this adds the playlists ticked since it started.
